C0688.title: Man Born in the 1990s Arrested for Reselling Pornographic Videos at a Markup, Earning Over 4,000 Yuan
C0688.summary: In July 2015, 20-year-old suspect Pan Xing purchased a cloud account containing pornographic videos for personal viewing. A seller later contacted him via QQ, after which he created QQ groups to distribute the videos for profit. He resold the purchased videos at a higher price, making over 4,000 yuan.
